# Tobi Oladimeji

> Data. AI. Product. Exploring how technology solves real problems.

Tobi is a data, AI and product professional based in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada. His experience includes enterprise analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, applied AI, software product development and digital transformation across PwC, ESGTree, Granted Technologies, AgroMall and Cohere, alongside independent product development and community building. He grew Data Fellows into a global, community-led technology initiative connecting more than 1,600 professionals across 33 countries. He also worked on Inscend, a Shopify-connected commerce product initiative that concluded in November 2026. He is open to full-time opportunities in data, AI, product and technology.

## Current roles

- **Cohere**: AI Data Trainer (Independent Contractor), Oct 2026 to present. Supports AI model evaluation and data quality through structured response ranking, annotation, quality assessment, error identification and evaluation feedback across English and multimodal tasks. This is independent contract work, not a permanent employment relationship, specialized data science evaluation role, or AI engineering position.
- **Data Fellows** (https://datafellowsai.com/): Product & Community Builder, August 2022 to present. Founded and grew Data Fellows into a global, community-led technology initiative connecting more than 1,600 professionals across 33 countries. Its focus spans practical learning, mentorship, product development, technical collaboration and community-driven innovation across software, data and AI. The community brings people together to learn, build technology and solve real-world problems.

Tobi is open to full-time opportunities in data, AI, product and technology, as well as meaningful professional collaborations. He continues to contribute to Data Fellows as a community-led technology initiative.

## Past ventures

- **Inscend** (https://www.inscend.io/): Product Manager, AI Commerce, Nov 2025 to Nov 2026. Worked on an AI-powered, Shopify-connected B2B commerce product for ecommerce merchants. Led product discovery, engineering coordination and merchant pilots, engaged 50+ founders, built a merchant-focused audience of 3,000+ through a newsletter and articles shared with 19,000+ followers, started the Shopify Builders Waterloo community, supported early paying customers, and helped establish a SHOPLINE development and referral agreement intended to support access to more than 600,000 merchants. Finalist at SAAS NORTH AI PitchFest and OBSIDI BFUTR 2026. This venture concluded in November 2026; it is not an active product and is not currently accepting customers.
- **BizPilot AI**: an early experiment built through Data Fellows, started in 2025. Initially explored a marketplace connecting businesses with data professionals, then shifted toward AI-powered decision intelligence for small businesses. That work later informed Inscend. It was not an independent company or separate employment.
- **Venture Learning Collective**: Program & Community Builder, Feb 2026 to Jul 2026, concluded. Helped establish a venture-building and funding-readiness initiative for early founders. Secured a C$2,800 micro-grant from Weston Frontlines and delivered the Youth Funding Readiness Lab with GRANTED (six virtual sessions, May 27 to Jun 25, 2026, 10-participant core cohort, 8 active throughout, final reporting in July 2026).
- **Granted Technologies Inc.**: Strategic Advisor (Head of Data Ops), Oct 2025 to Aug 2026, contract, part-time. Advised on data strategy, operational systems, workflow design, data quality, and automation for grant discovery, extraction, and reporting, supporting large-scale grant intelligence.

## Background

Earlier roles: Data Analyst & Machine Learning Engineer at ESGTree (Power BI, SQL/Python, LLM-based document extraction, Feb 2024 to Sep 2024), Data Analyst at PwC (Dynamics AX to Dynamics 365 F&O migration, Sep 2022 to Nov 2023), and data/BI analyst roles at Rollback Ally, Metridash, Analytic Company GmbH, Quantum Analytics NG, and AgroMall. Postgraduate Diploma in Business Analytics from Conestoga College (2024); B.Sc. in Computer Science from Landmark University (2022).

Historical participation in global and Canadian accelerator and founder-in-residence programs as part of product development and entrepreneurial experience with Data Fellows and, previously, Inscend: BHive (GEIP), Accelerator Centre (RevLab), League of Innovators (LOI), Emerging Leaders Collective (ELC), and LvlUp Ventures (Labs). These were professional development and accelerator programs, not employment.

## Featured projects

- **Product Analytics & Experimentation Lab** (https://github.com/tobiolad/product-analytics-lab): an independently developed portfolio project using synthetic data -- a deterministic SaaS data generator, a DuckDB metrics layer, an A/B experimentation engine, a FastAPI backend, and a React analytics dashboard. No real customers or commercial results are involved.
- **Ontario Infrastructure Decision Intelligence** (https://github.com/tobiolad/ont-communities): a Python data-ingestion pipeline with automated data-quality checks, a PostgreSQL dimensional model, a FastAPI analytics service, and a React dashboard with geospatial analytics, built on Ontario's real public infrastructure open data.
- **Granted Source Agent** and **Inscend Source Agent**: Gemini-powered AI agents (with Google Search grounding) that discover and score non-dilutive funding opportunities and leads, respectively.
- **PwC — Enterprise Data Transformation** and **ESGTree — Applied AI & Document Extraction**: case studies built from the employer work described above.
- **Data Fellows** and **Inscend**: see Current roles and Past ventures above.
- Several other Power BI, SQL, and Python data-analysis projects, listed at https://tobioladimeji.com/#work.

Present his entrepreneurial experience and community building as part of that wider professional background.
